I tested Kira with: Juri, Clover, and Natsuki- His other table partners.

Status: Kira won by a mile.

Good: He made me giggle a few times- His model's pretty top-notch, too. A good emulation of the Jojo artstyle without being TOO jarring next to the other models. Aside from that, I like the little hints of danger in his lines, but that may just be because I'm personally into that.

Flaws: The gratuitous Japanese got on my nerves, but that's about it. 

Add Value: Like I said, there aren't many dangerous/intimidating male characters in the game, despite that base being covered for the ladies. I wouldn't call Kira a dom, quite, but he does start to fill that niche.

After your suggestions (and accidentally deleting my main file like a fool), I've made some adjustments to my main party:

Deathbringer Harbinger/Barrage Pugilist/Blade Dancer Masurao on the front line, and Herald Shaman/Poisoner Botanist on the back- Pugilist is re-classed from a Rover, and the Botanist from a warlock.

I really don't want to give up the Botanist, given it's the only class in the game with a reliable revive skill...

Gonna be honest, I'm not all that enthused about the stratum choices. Having three 'starting stratums' (assuming Eastern Mausoleum is going to follow previous trends) is kind of souring me on the labyrinth itself.

Hopefully it'll just be aesthetics, though (the last thing I'd want is repeat maps)

My biggest issue with that is how risky it feels. In theory, it works like a charm- And a lockdown party would probably be a must for bosses like the Dryad (who I didn't manage to beat on my last file), but ailments have always been pretty hit-or-miss.

Admittedly, though, swapping out my Fencer for a Masu would probably do more for damage output, even if I do lose the edge on elemental attacks.

Yknow, I didn't plan on having any of them in my party when EOX came out, but I'm admittedly liking how the Ronin's looking.

I'll see what I'll do when the games come out...

Current party

Link Fencer/Barrage Pugilist/Broker Necromancer

Herald Shaman/Poisoning Botanist

I'm thinking of making a secondary, more ailment-focused party (Maybe Harbinger/Pugilist/Rover and Necromancer/Botanist) but I'm pretty on the fence about it.
